notes: even as is kept whole on καθώς under rule 82, which records that καθώς never takes so; with no correlative word written, the intensifying καί is unrepresented under rule 65's English-side test.
καρδιογνώστης heads on knoweth as the word carrying the -γνώστης element; the note records the head on heart as the competing reading.
ἡμῖν carries the supplied he did unto us, its comparative clause having no other token; rules 56 and 68.
